apps.description: Interview intelligence — structured question banks, answer scoring rubrics, bias flags, debrief summaries.
Talent pool rediscovery — resurfaces silver-medalists from the ATS matched to new reqs.
Offer letter builder — comp band validation, clause templates, e-sign routing.
Performance review copilot — evidence collection, calibration notes, bias-language checks.
Learning path designer — skill gap to course mapping, cohort plans, completion nudges.
Exit interview analyzer — theme extraction across exits, attrition driver ranking.
Workforce planning radar — headcount forecast vs budget, attrition scenarios, hiring prioritization.
